items.title: Use spiritofthefrontrange.org for your new site
items.detail: Your new site is live on a free address. When you're happy with it, we'll help you point spiritofthefrontrange.org at it — your old site keeps working until then.

items.title: Use your own font licence
items.detail: Your old site used Bricolage Grotesque Variable and Public Sans Variable, which we're not allowed to copy, so the closest free fonts stand in (Bricolage Grotesque, Rosarivo). If you have a web licence, download the font files (WOFF2) from the font service and upload them in Site Styles → Your fonts — they're stored in media/fonts/ — then choose them for your headings and text.
